$comment: The cabin at Lake Quinault, home (GAME_DESIGN 2.2, 12.3, 12.18; BUILD_PLAN S7): the next-step button's states (home.next.<id>, content/home/cabin.json next), the porch rail's words, which are also the labels on the picture (home.rail.<id>, lead call 57), each place's name, for a long press and VoiceOver (home.place.<id>), the line under a place whose screen comes later (home.soon, lead call 59), and the mailbox's Text toggle (home.mail.*, lead call 63; the Sound toggle is the status line's). Drafts until B002 is answered; preview only.

home.soon.ctx: Under a rail button or a place whose screen comes later (the shed, the car, the fire bowl), and on main under the disabled next step

home.rail.gear.ctx: The rail and the shed's label: your gear, then the flat lay (S12a)

home.rail.drive.ctx: The rail and the car's label: to town or the trailhead (S11)

home.rail.stories.ctx: The rail and the fire bowl's label: trip reports (S15a)

home.rail.mailbox.ctx: The rail and the mailbox's label: settings

home.place.door.ctx: The door's name: a long press, and VoiceOver's name for its hit area

home.place.mailbox.ctx: The mailbox's name, and the settings sheet's name at the cabin

home.mail.text_pixel.ctx: The mailbox's Text toggle while the box text is the pixel font (tap: Plain)

home.mail.text_plain.ctx: The mailbox's Text toggle while the box text is the Plain serif (tap: pixel)
